probes.What is a toothbrush?: A toothbrush is a device used to clean teeth, typically consisting of a flexible, bristle-like brush that is inserted into the mouth to remove food debris and plaque from between teeth and along the gumline. The bristles are usually made of nylon or plastic and are designed to gently scrape the surfaces of teeth without damaging gums or enamel. Toothbrushes are often used as an alternative to dental pliers or as a supplement to professional dental cleanings.
